name: Get sidebar contact count
description: Call this when you need the contact count shown in the automation sidebar for the currently viewed automation. If you need a reliable count of contacts for a list or segment, use the contacts count endpoint instead.
preconditions: The user must be viewing an automation in the Brevo UI (e.g., /automation/advanced or /automation/automations).
A valid automation ID must be present in the request context.

error.description: Error message describing why the contact count could not be retrieved.
